races.verdict: Despite meeting with defeat for the first time, ARAPAHO GOLD arguably enhanced his reputation trying to concede weight all round in the Mill Reef at Newbury and he looks a very solid proposition in this good-quality opening race. Inner City Blues remains a top prospect despite a slightly underwhelming effort in the Middle Park, while Night In Vegas has already had a lucrative season and can make his presence felt again. ARAPAHO GOLD (IRE) INNER CITY BLUES (IRE) NIGHT IN VEGAS (IRE)

races.verdict: Joseph O'Brien's upwardly-mobile stayer HIGHWAYMAN can add to his St Leger triumph and extend his winning sequence to 4 with this first go over 2m bound to suit. Caballo de Mar is a big threat on the back of his game Prix du Cadran success from the absent Scandinavia, although the rejuvenated Gregory is also well in the mix and Ebor 1-3 Daiquiri Bay and Opportunity rate lively outsiders too in this fascinating clash. HIGHWAYMAN (FR) CABALLO DE MAR (IRE) GREGORY

races.display_title: Qatar Racing British Champions Fillies & Mares Stakes (Group 1)
races.verdict: Remarkable mare KALPANA has had some tough battles this year but may have enough left in the tank to secure a third successive victory in this race. Minnie Hauk 's standout effort this season came when runner-up in the Prince of Wales's Stakes here, and she's feared most if recapturing that sort of form. Sparan Nua was narrowly touched off by Kalpana at York and could be worth another chance to confirm that improvement, while impressive Irish Oaks winner Johanna Walsh isn't taken lightly. KALPANA MINNIE HAUK (IRE) SPARAN NUA (IRE)

races.verdict: AT THE WINGS has been thriving of late and is fancied to defy another rise in the weights and complete his hat-trick, with the longer trip expected to suit. races.verdict: The market should reveal plenty in this fascinating maiden but the vote goes to Paddy Twomey's unraced Justify colt DRIVE ON THERE who appeals on pedigree and holds an entry in next spring's Irish 2000 Guineas. Aidan O'Brien saddles three and his Wootton Bassett debutant Accumulation also commands plenty of respect. Critical Reason shaped well on his recent Curragh debut and could emerge as the pick of those with experience ahead of Naas debut third First Watch . DRIVE ON THERE (USA) ACCUMULATION (IRE) CRITICAL REASON (IRE)

races.display_title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Nursery Handicap
races.verdict: ADMIRED BEAUTY resumed her progress when gaining a breakthrough success at Naas recently and with Billy Lee an eye-catching booking for the yard she is fancied to make a winning start to life in nurseries here. Snapequus also looks to have better days ahead of him, though, and rates a major threat, while City of Gold and Banks of The Boyne can have a say too in this intriguing nursery. ADMIRED BEAUTY (IRE) SNAPEQUUS (IRE) CITY OF GOLD
